title: What If the World Forced You to Marry Your CRUSH?
description:
Monday, 7:02 AM. Every phone on Earth buzzes at once: every eighteen-year-old on the planet has been matched. Gus got Brooke, the most popular girl in school. His crush got the quarterback. Only the top ten couples get to switch on Friday — and the whole world is voting.

Two questions for the comments:
1) Switch or stay? One word.
2) Who would the world have matched YOU with? Name them. I already know it's the wrong one.

Lia voted before anyone else did. The least you can do is subscribe.


Real facts in this episode: how common arranged marriage still is, Galton's ox and the wisdom of crowds, why Greece and Cyprus always vote for each other, what long-term studies say about chosen vs. arranged couples, and the reluctant candidate effect.

#whatif #gusmaybe #crush #animation #school
